topic: Student strike at Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (Cuet) demanding reinstatement of dismissed vice-chancellor Prof Dr Abu Sadat Muhammad Sayem; teachers, staff and employees joined the work stoppage
scale: Campus-wide complete shutdown at Cuet halting all academic and administrative activities for 14+ consecutive days; teachers, staff and employees in work stoppage; thousands of students affected; protest extended to a Chattogram city demonstration on 6 October
quote1: Students of Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (Cuet) have taken their protest to Chattogram city after demonstrating on campus for 14 consecutive days, demanding the reinstatement of former vice-chancellor Prof Dr Abu Sadat Muhammad Sayem.
quote2: The move prompted student protests, leading to a campus-wide shutdown from September 22.
